headline: Phillies rally from four down to stretch win streak to nine
recap: The Phillies trailed the Cardinals 4-0 entering the bottom of the ninth Sunday at Citizens Bank Park, then scored six runs for a walk-off 6-4 win. Bryan De La Cruz's RBI double, Edmundo Sosa's three-run double and Kyle Schwarber's two-run homer drove in the rally against Cardinals reliever Riley O'Brien, who was charged with the loss after recording only two outs. Cristopher Sanchez started for Philadelphia and allowed four runs over 6.2 innings with seven strikeouts; Tim Mayza followed with 1.1 scoreless innings and Alex McFarlane worked a scoreless ninth to pick up the win.
The win was Philadelphia's ninth in a row. The Phillies are 73-58, in second place in the NL East, three games behind the first-place Atlanta Braves.

Philadelphia opens a three-game series at Seattle on Monday, with first pitch at 9:41 PM ET. Zack Wheeler starts for the Phillies opposite Mariners right-hander Logan Gilbert. Philadelphia is a -115 moneyline favorite, with Seattle at -104.
